title: Consecutive Interpretation: Healthcare Guide
summary: Learn how consecutive interpretation works in healthcare, why turn length matters, how it differs from simultaneous interpretation.
body_markdown:
###


Consecutive interpretation is a spoken-language workflow where one person speaks, pauses, and the interpreter delivers that message in another language before the conversation continues.


###


Consecutive interpretation alternates between speakers and interpretation. Simultaneous interpretation occurs while the source speaker continues talking, usually with a short delay.


###


Short, complete turns reduce memory load and make it easier to preserve numbers, medication instructions, negative statements, uncertainty, and other meaning-sensitive details.


###


Yes. AI medical interpretation can process each speaking turn and return the interpreted speech in real time. Clear audio and good turn-taking still matter.


###


Speak directly to the patient, use one complete idea per turn, separate numbers and medication instructions, avoid overlapping speech, and pause for the patient's response.
